scoring_justification: Results are single numeric values from analytical saddle-point solutions and variational optimization; recomputing from raw artifacts is not feasible because the checker cannot re-run the agent's solver. We compare the agent's reported values to the paper's reported values using tolerances that absorb legitimate toolchain spread.
